title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.


Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.


Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.




Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Conhecimento em estatística e técnicas de Machine Learning

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.


Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

description:

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction

  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools

  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.


The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.


About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.


What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)


You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects


What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary


Want some Bonus Points?

We've set up an MCP server at ` - candidates who know what to do with it will find something useful

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About VEL

Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building chat interfaces.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.


The Role

The Chief of Staff is the CEO’s strategic execution partner — responsible for converting executive intent into structured, measurable execution across the company.


You will operate across:

● Product (Physical AI systems)

● Fundraise and capital coordination

● Manufacturing partners

● Real estate and deployment strategy

● International expansion

● Board and investor communications


This is not an administrative role.

This is not calendar management.

This is a cross-functional force multiplier role embedded in high-velocity decision environments.


You will:

● Translate CEO strategy into executable workstreams

● Drive OKR cadence and operational rhythm

● Prepare board materials and investor updates

● Support capital raise execution and investor coordination

● Maintain discipline across execution systems (Monday.com, Miro, etc.)

● Identify risk early and enforce accountability

● Coordinate cross-border stakeholders

This role requires executive maturity, commercial literacy, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● Minimum 3 years serving as Chief of Staff reporting directly to a CEO

● Experience in a venture-backed or high-growth environment

● Direct exposure to capital raise cycles

● Ownership of board-level documentation and reporting

● Financial literacy (runway, unit economics, forecasting inputs)

● Experience implementing structured execution systems

● Strong English communication

● Willingness to travel extensively

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup in growth stage

● An infrastructure, hardware, or deep-tech environment

● A company operating across multiple countries

● A high-velocity environment with capital exposure


You understand that:

● Execution discipline determines survival

● Capital alignment drives strategy

● Ambiguity is normal at scale-building companies

● Board-level communication must be precise

● Travel is part of building global infrastructure

You prefer ownership over supervision.

You are comfortable operating without detailed instructions.


Who Should Not Apply

● Executive Assistants repositioning as Chief of Staff

● Strategy consultants without operating accountability

● Candidates without capital exposure

● Individuals unwilling to travel 90–120 days per year

● Candidates seeking low-intensity environments

What We Offer

● Direct CEO exposure

● Global operational footprint

● Board-level experience

● Infrastructure-scale problem set

● Equity upside

● Responsibility for execution coherence across the company

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Liderar a expansão comercial em mercados estratégicos, gerando valor por meio de relações de longo prazo com distribuidoras de gás e energia elétrica, geradores, grandes indústrias e demais players relevantes do setor.

  • Visão estratégica e forte orientação a resultados
  • Ética profissional inegociável

Buscamos um profissional com mentalidade empreendedora, disposto a construir, escalar e assumir um papel de liderança estratégica no médio prazo.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora .NET - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver aplicações Backend .NET

Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes , analisando e depurando códigos com ferramentas como IDEs e DevTools do navegador (F12).

Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com .NET Core e Entity Framework.

Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura de software , como DDD (Domain-Driven Design), injeção de dependência e testes unitários.

Trabalhar com mensageria , principalmente RabbitMQ, mas também com alternativas como SQS, SNS ou Kafka.

Projetar e manter sistemas distribuídos baseados em microserviços.

Monitorar e diagnosticar aplicações usando ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: DataDog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).

Utilizar bancos de dados não relacionais , como MongoDB ou DynamoDB.

Participar de pipelines de CI/CD , garantindo entregas contínuas e seguras.

Trabalhar com tecnologias de containerização e orquestração , como Docker e Kubernetes.

Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.

Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.

  • Experiencia com .NET
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ
  • Experiencia com sistemas distribuídos, com microserviços que interagem entre si;
  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experiencia com ambiente de trabalho com estrutura de CI-CD
  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps


Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Estruturação de Playbook
description:
Estamos estruturando um contrato pontual para desenvolvimento de um Playbook Operacional completo de CONTABILIDADE (FISCAL, CONTABIL E PESSOAL) , com foco na organização e padronização das rotinas contábeis, fiscais e de departamento pessoal para três regimes empresariais: MEI, Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido - com utilização do sistema contábil DOMÍNIO DA THOMSON REUTERS (ESSENCIAL).


O projeto consiste na construção detalhada do passo a passo de todas as obrigações recorrentes e acessórias de cada regime, incluindo:

– Rotinas mensais, trimestrais e anuais

– Obrigações principais e acessórias

– Prazos, bases de cálculo e responsáveis

– Procedimentos internos de conferência

– Fluxo de entrega e validação

– Pontos críticos e riscos comuns


O modelo de trabalho será 100% remoto, com demonstração prática das etapas em reuniões online. A estruturação e documentação do Playbook será realizada por colaboradora interna da Back4You durante as reuniões. Ao final, o material consolidado deverá ser revisado para validação técnica, ajustes e aprovação final.


Trata-se de um contrato por projeto , com escopo definido e prazo determinado. Caso haja alinhamento técnico, cultural e operacional, poderá ser considerada integração futura ao time .



Buscamos alguém com domínio técnico sólido em rotinas contábeis, fiscais e trabalhistas , visão organizacional, capacidade de estruturar processos e experiência prática nos três regimes.

description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)

  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (21+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)

Diferenciais

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

title: Jornalista Sênior | Head de Projetos de Conteúdo Digital & Comercial
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) jornalista sênior , com forte vivência digital , perfil executivo altamente organizado e experiência na área comercial comprovada , para atuar na gestão, estruturação e monetização de múltiplos projetos editoriais e digitais do Canal Matheus Baldi (Instagram, Youtube, TikTok, Kwai e Spotify).


Buscamos um(a) profissional com disponibilidade integral para assumir a gestão executiva, comercial e operacional dos projetos. Essa é uma posição de altíssima responsabilidade.


Procuramos alguém com mentalidade de dono , compromisso com metas e resultado e enorme disposição .


Modelo PJ | Dedicação integral aos projetos


Atenção: Essa não é uma vaga para redator ou social media. Busco alguém com perfil executivo que tenha experiência em organizar projetos, liderar equipe e gerar receita com vendas de cotas publicitárias.


Missão da Posição:

Transformar visão editorial em operação estruturada e receita recorrente.

A pessoa será responsável por organizar fluxos, coordenar equipes, desenvolver oportunidades comerciais e garantir que todas as frentes operem com método, clareza e resultado.


Principais frentes sob responsabilidade:

• Organização de cronogramas, fluxos e calendário estratégico de projetos digitais e audiovisuais

• Implantação, monitoramento e consolidação de relatórios

• Desenvolvimento e estruturação comercial de formatos, cotas e integrações

• Prospecção ativa de marcas e parceiros estratégicos

• Condução de reuniões comerciais e negociações

• Elaboração de propostas personalizadas

• Venda de projetos e acompanhamento do fechamento até a entrega final

• Controle de metas comerciais e acompanhamento de resultados

• Curadoria e organização diária de conteúdo sobre bastidores da fama (celebridades) e do poder (política e mercado)

• Supervisão e revisão de roteiros, legendas e narrativas multiplataforma

• Estruturação de crescimento estratégico em redes sociais (com foco em X)

• Gestão operacional de comunidade e integração com estratégia de relacionamento e monetização

• Coordenação de equipe (assistente, edição e comercial)

• Criação e manutenção de sistema estruturado de gestão

• Garantia de alinhamento entre conteúdo, comercial e entregas

• Relacionamento e acompanhamento de projetos com marcas das quais Matheus Baldi tem contrato

Perfil que buscamos:

• Formação em Jornalismo ou Comunicação Social

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência digital comprovada

• Excelente redação e domínio narrativo

• Experiência com jornalismo de celebridades e bastidores política/mercado

• Experiência organizando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

• Forte capacidade comercial e de negociação

• Conforto em trabalhar com metas e geração de receita

• Alta capacidade de organização e controle de dados

• Autonomia e postura resolutiva

• Mentalidade de dono e visão estratégica

Criatividade é bem-vinda, mas organização, execução e comercial são as prioridades.

Atenção! Formato híbrido, com predominância de trabalho remoto (cerca de 80%) e encontros presenciais pontuais. Mas, é preciso que more em São Paulo (capital) ou na Grande São Paulo.


Modelo de remuneração:

Prestação de serviço (PJ), com remuneração fixa mensal compatível com senioridade.

Além do fixo:

Participação de 3% sobre todos os contratos captados e vendidos diretamente pelo(a) profissional .

O pagamento da participação acompanha a forma de recebimento acordada com o cliente, respeitando parcelas e prazos definidos em contrato.

Buscamos alguém que compreenda metas, receita e crescimento sustentável.


Não é a vaga ideal se:

• Você prefere apenas escrever e não negociar

• Não tem experiência real em vendas ou captação

• Nunca organizou múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

• Precisa de supervisão constante

• Trabalha apenas por carga horária

• Não tem experiência sólida em jornalismo digital

Essa posição exige maturidade profissional, responsabilidade e visão de negócio.


Como se candidatar:


Favor enviar:


  • Portfólio com 3 a 8 links de trabalhos publicados (matérias, vídeos, campanhas e/ou projetos digitais), indicando sua função em cada um deles.
  • Breve descrição de um projeto que você estruturou do zero
  • Exemplo de propostas comerciais que você já tenha desenvolvido
  • Resposta objetiva (até 10 linhas): “Como você organizaria múltiplos projetos editoriais simultâneos e ao mesmo tempo desenvolveria a frente comercial?”

Enviar para o e-mail: (Precisa enviar tudo por e-mail)


Colocar no título do e-mail: Head Projetos & Comercial


*Fundamental informar sua pretensão salarial no e-mail e disponibilidade para início do trabalho (temos urgência).


*Candidaturas sem portfólio, exemplo de proposta comercial e resposta à pergunta estratégica não serão analisadas.

title: Gerente de HRBP
description:
Principais Desafios:

  • Parceria Estratégica: Traduzir metas de negócio em estratégias de Gente & Cultura (workforce planning e estruturas organizacionais).
  • Gestão de Performance e Sucessão: Liderar ciclos de metas, calibração, PDIs e mapeamento de sucessores, garantindo meritocracia e desenvolvimento.
  • Cultura e Clima: Diagnosticar o cenário das unidades atendidas e implementar planos de ação focados no engajamento e retenção.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Conduzir reestruturações e novos modelos operacionais, mitigando riscos e garantindo a comunicação fluida.
  • People Analytics: Monitorar indicadores (turnover, clima, performance) para gerar insights executivos e recomendações práticas à liderança.
  • Governança e Compliance: Garantir a aplicação das políticas de RH, relações trabalhistas e diretrizes éticas com excelência técnica.
  • Liderança de Time: Mentorar e desenvolver a equipe de HRBPs, elevando o nível de consultividade e autonomia do time.



O que buscamos:

  • Formação: Graduação em Psicologia, Administração ou áreas correlatas (Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas é desejável).
  • Experiência: Sólida trajetória em Gestão de RH, Cultura Organizacional e atuação como Business Partner.
  • Mindset Analítico: Conforto em trabalhar com métricas de pessoas e automação de processos.
  • Soft Skills: Liderança inspiradora, resiliência para lidar com ambientes complexos e excelente habilidade de influência.


Informações adicionais:

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Técnico de Ferramentaria I
description:
Venha fazer parte da Nação Azul!


Como será o seu dia a dia :


Controlar, organizar e zelar pelas ferramentas utilizadas nas máquinas de produção, garantindo sua conservação, rastreabilidade e plena disponibilidade para uso;


Preparar, conferir e liberar ferramentas para realização dos setups das máquinas antes do início dos processos produtivos;


Controlar e organizar as Ordens de Produção (OPs), verificando especificações técnicas dos produtos (medidas, tolerâncias, espessuras e demais requisitos);


Conferir o ferramental separado pelo Assistente Técnico de Ferramentaria, garantindo conformidade com as OPs e disponibilidade para preparação dos equipamentos;


Participar e acompanhar, junto ao Operador, a preparação (setup) das máquinas: substituir, montar e ajustar ferramentas conforme dimensões especificadas;


Acompanhar operação-teste dos equipamentos, realizar conferência dimensional, efetuar ajustes necessários e liberar máquina para produção;


Manter organização e limpeza do local de trabalho, equipamentos e ferramentas, solicitando serviços de manutenção quando necessário;


Cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos de segurança, utilizando corretamente os EPIs;


Atualizar e controlar periodicamente o inventário físico do ferramental sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo acuracidade dos ativos;


Registrar e acompanhar o status do ferramental (ativo, inativo, em manutenção ou descartável), bem como suas características técnicas, por meio de planilhas ou sistemas, para correta identificação, separação e encaminhamento à produção.


Para fazer acontecer, você precisa (Mandatórios) :


Ensino Técnico completo em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Ferramentaria, Usinagem ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência prévia com ferramental, setups de máquinas e leitura de desenhos técnicos;

Conhecimentos em metrologia (paquímetro, micrômetro, relógio comparador);

Noções de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em ferramentas;

Conhecimento básico em informática (Excel/ Planilhas ou sistemas de controle).


Será considerado como Diferencial:


Experiência em ambiente industrial farmacêutico, alimentício ou cosmético;

Conhecimento em Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF);

Vivência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção ou controle de ativos.


Modelo de trabalho : 100% Presencial em Santo Amaro | São Paulo / SP

Oferecemos:

Assistência Médica

Assistência Odontológica

Auxílio Farmácia

Auxílio Creche (Exclusivo para Mulheres)

Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados

Previdência Privada

Restaurante Interno

Seguro de Vida

Apsen Cuida

Vale Alimentação

Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento

Gympass (Wellhub)

Na Apsen , incentivamos a participação de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, 50+ e pessoas com deficiência. Temos o compromisso em promover diversidade, e acreditamos ser o caminho para a construção de um mundo melhor e mais justo, e que precisa ser começado dentro da nossa própria casa, então, junte-se à Nação Azul !

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
We are hiring!


Please find the job description below. If you're interested, I would appreciate it if you could share your updated resume with me.


Role: Principal Business Performance Analyst

Location: LATAM - Remote

Type: Contract

Job Description:

We are seeking a Principal Business Performance Analyst to drive personalization and affiliate marketing analytics within our Marketing Technology team. This role focuses on turning complex data into actionable insights that improve user experience, conversions, and recurring revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze the impact of personalization initiatives on key user and business metrics
  • Deliver actionable insights from affiliate performance data to drive conversion and revenue growth
  • Lead A/B and multivariate testing to optimize affiliate offers, landing pages, and user journeys
  • Develop customer segmentation and attribution models to evaluate campaign effectiveness
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau, Data Studio, or similar tools
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Tech teams to improve funnel performance and affiliate strategy


Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced analytics using Python or R
  • Experience with A/B testing, personalization, and experimentation
  • Hands-on experience with affiliate marketing analytics
  • Expertise with data platforms such as BigQuery, AWS Athena, or AWS Glue
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Senior/Lead Product Designer
description:
Please, send your resume in English. Only English resumes will be accepted. Candidates also must submit a portfolio.


Company Description

Valere is an award-winning partner specializing in AI transformation and custom software solutions, helping businesses evolve into AI-driven organizations. Recognized as a top 1% expert-vetted agency on platforms like Upwork, Clutch, and G2, Valere collaborates with private equity firms, mid-market businesses, and Fortune 500 enterprises to provide measurable ROI through innovative AI strategies. Backed by a team of over 220 experienced professionals, Valere delivers tailored end-to-end solutions using its proven \"crawl-walk-run\" methodology, supporting every stage of the AI journey from strategy development to seamless implementation. Valere combines high-quality standards with cost-effective models to deliver meaningful results to its clients.


Role Description

The Senior / Lead Product Designer drives design excellence across enterprise client engagements at Valere Digital — owning end-to-end product design from discovery through delivery, while shaping design culture, process, and standards. This role requires demonstrated experience designing AI-native products and active fluency in using AI tools to accelerate design work.


Responsibilities


Product Design

 • Lead design of user-centric solutions for enterprise clients — from concept to implementation —

  including high-fidelity prototypes, user flows, wireframes, UX diagrams, and design specs.

 • Review existing application UI/UX, capture required modifications, and drive product decisions.

 • Ensure visual and experiential consistency across client products and touchpoints.

 • Lead design reviews and critiques to uphold quality standards.

 • Compile stakeholder requirements into product information architecture.

 • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver cohesive customer journeys.

 • Champion design goals to peers, engineers, and leadership.

 • Serve as the primary design point of contact across allocated client projects.

 • Support user research and usability testing design where applicable.



AI-Native Design

 • Lead design of AI-native products — conversational interfaces, agentic workflows, copilot

  experiences, and AI-assisted features — with clear command of what makes AI interactions

  intuitive, transparent, and trustworthy.

 • Apply AI-specific UX patterns: prompt design, uncertainty and error handling, streaming

  output display, human-in-the-loop flows, and model feedback mechanisms.

 • Translate complex AI capabilities into accessible, delightful experiences without sacrificing

  user agency or transparency.

 • Partner with engineering and data science to design for dynamic, probabilistic AI outputs.

 • Advocate for responsible AI design: fairness, explainability, and ethical interaction design.

 • Establish AI interaction patterns and components within Valere Digital's design system.



Leadership & Growth

 • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Designers within Valere Digital.

 • Support Valere Digital's design strategy and ensure alignment with broader company objectives.

 • Foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation across the UX/UI team.

 • Ensure client business goals are met and stakeholders are informed of key design decisions.

 • Proactively identify and resolve dependencies and challenges across engagements.

 • Onboard new team members and maintain quality and consistency across design efforts.

 • Establish and operationalize Valere Digital design processes, templates, and deliverables.

 • Maintain a consistent design language and formal design system.

 • Support Valere-related marketing efforts and contribute to creative strategy and budgeting.

 • Promote a collaborative, knowledge-sharing team culture.


Qualifications


Core Design

 • 5+ years of product design experience leading end-to-end UX/UI for complex digital products.

 • Mastery of IA, interaction design, visual design, and design systems.

 • Proficiency in Figma or equivalent tools; strong prototyping and specification skills.

 • Experience leading design reviews and presenting to executive stakeholders.


AI-Native Product Design

 • Demonstrated experience designing AI-native products where AI is core to the user experience —

  including conversational interfaces, copilots, agentic flows, or ML-powered features.

 • Ability to design for AI-specific behaviors: uncertainty, latency, streaming outputs,

  multi-turn interactions, and confidence signaling.

 • Experience collaborating with AI/ML engineers to bridge technical constraints with

  user-centered design.


AI Tools for Design Acceleration

 • Demonstrated use of AI-powered tools to augment and expedite rapid prototyping and design

  iteration — such as Galileo AI, Uizard, Figma AI, v0 by Vercel, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly,

  or equivalent platforms.

 • Proven ability to integrate AI-assisted workflows into team practice while maintaining

  design quality, coherence, and client standards.

 • Skilled in prompting and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs — using AI to

  augment design judgment, not replace it.


Leadership

 • Experience leading and mentoring designers in a client-facing or agency environment.

 • Ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements and competing priorities.

 • Track record of contributing to or establishing design systems and organizational UX standards.


Portfolio Requirement


Candidates must submit a portfolio that includes:


 • At least one AI-native UX/UI project (shipped or prototype) where AI is central to the experience - demonstrating how you handled model outputs, uncertainty, and human-AI interaction.

 • Additional entries showing end-to-end design ownership across enterprise digital products.

 • At least one case study walking through your full design process.


Portfolios without demonstrated AI-native design experience will not be considered.

Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Marketing de Conteúdo (Social Media / Creator Economy)
description:

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
International Assistant Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.

  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500

Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Subgerente de Unidade de Insumos e Grãos
description:
Confira abaixo nossa oportunidade para atuar como Subgerente de Unidade de Insumos e Grãos no Rio Grande do Sul/RS .


Faça agora mesmo sua candidatura e venha conosco despertar nas pessoas um mundo mais próspero!


Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  • Coordena processos administrativos, financeiros e de crédito rural;
  • Responsável pela sustentabilidade e conformidade dos processos da unidade;
  • Realiza gestão de pessoas;
  • Realiza atendimento aos clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando os últimos semestres em áreas relacionadas ao agronegócio, gestão ou ciências exatas;
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e/ou processos;
  • Disponibilidade de mudança/mobilidade para as regiões de atuação da C.Vale no Rio Grande do Sul/RS.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com gestão administrativa e financeira no agronegócio;
  • Experiência com crédito rural e atendimento ao produto.


Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de assistência odontológica;
  • Plano de assistência médica;
  • Treinamentos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento;
  • Universidade corporativa;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados.


A C.Vale disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.


Regime de atuação CLT, com remuneração mensal.


Estado: Rio Grande do Sul - Vaga sem localidade fixa, exigindo disponibilidade para atuar (mudança) nas cidades de atuação da C.Vale.


O Programa Formação de Líderes C.Vale/Imersão de Subgerente de Unidade de Insumos e Grãos é um projeto de desenvolvimento da cultura C.Vale teórico-prático que visa formar líderes para cargos de gestão, como gerentes, nas Unidades de Insumos e Grãos da Cooperativa.

Como participante deste programa, você terá a oportunidade de passar por um processo de 6 a 12 meses dentro de uma ou mais Unidades da C.Vale, o que requer disponibilidade para mudança. Desde o processo seletivo até o desenvolvimento, consideramos as particularidades de cada profissional, proporcionando uma trilha personalizada de desenvolvimento.

O Programa Formação de Líderes C.Vale oferece experiências que desafiam profissionais de todos os níveis de maturidade e experiência, preparando-os para assumir posições de liderança com sucesso.

description:

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer - Opportunity in Brazil (100% remote)


Location: Fully Remote

Contract: PJ (open-ended)


About the Role

One of our US-based clients is looking for a kind, curious, and collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex and meaningful problems.

This team is responsible for building seamless and compelling experiences that make it easy for individuals to consign luxury items. We place a strong emphasis on personal growth, technical excellence, and a highly collaborative engineering culture.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on contributor while also influencing technical direction. You will lead impactful initiatives, participate in architectural decisions, and provide mentorship through thoughtful code reviews and pair programming.

If you are excited about luxury retail, e-commerce, or sustainability—and passionate about contributing to a circular economy for high-end goods—this role is for you.

  • Fluency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript) , HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with React and the broader React ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows
  • Familiarity with TypeScript
  • Understanding of event-based architectures
  • Strong database fundamentals
  • Experience working with GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for solving user-centric problems with technology


Desired Skills

  • Experience extracting or building microservices from a monolithic architecture
  • Interest in luxury retail, e-commerce, or high-end consignment markets
  • Passion for sustainability and circular economy initiatives


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred
  • Equivalent professional experience considered

description:

  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Matrix IFS is looking for a Data Scientist, the job involves working with client data to develop and implement fraud detection models, which includes data cleaning, feature engineering, and model tuning. Responsibilities also include collaborating with clients and internal teams, communicating findings, and contributing to product development by creating scalable data pipelines and improving processes.

Key skills required are proficiency in Python (including libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn), machine learning, distributed computing (like PySpark), and strong communication abilities.

Core responsibilities

  • Data analysis and modeling: Understand client data, perform data cleaning and preprocessing, and develop and tune machine learning models.
  • Collaboration: Work with internal teams (Product, Research) and external stakeholders (clients) to understand business objectives and ensure client success.
  • Technical leadership: Provide technical guidance, drive project execution, and contribute to building scalable data pipelines and prototypes.
  • Product development: Help improve the product by contributing to solution development, keeping up with fraud prevention trends, and creating generalized product enhancements.
  • Communication: Clearly communicate complex findings and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key skills and qualifications

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python, including scientific stack libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn) and experience with distributed computing tools like PySpark.
  • Machine Learning: Expertise in machine learning concepts and algorithms.
  • Data Manipulation: Experience with data cleaning, feature engineering, and building scalable data pipelines (e.g., with Airflow and Trino).
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex ideas to various stakeholders.
  • Analytical: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex financial crime challenges.

Education: A degree in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related area is often required.

Why Matrix

Matrix is a global, dynamic, fast-growing technical consultancy leading technology services company with 13000 employees worldwide. Since its foundation in 2001, Matrix has made more travelers and acquisitions and has executed some of the largest, most significant. The company specializes in implementing and developing leading technologies, software solutions, and products. It provides its customers with infrastructure and consulting services, IT outsourcing, offshore, training and assimilation, and Ves as representatives for the world's leading software vendors. With vast experience in private and public sectors, ranging from Finance, Telecom, Health, Hi-Tech, Education, Defense, and Secu city, Matrix's customer base includes guest organizations in Israel and a steadily growing client base worldwide.

We are comprised of talented, creative, and dedicated individuals passionate about delivering innovative solutions to the market. We source and foster the best talent and recognize that all employee's contributions are integral to our company's future.

Matrix- success is based on a challenging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and rewarding career opportunities. We encourage a diverse work environment of sharing, learning, and ceding together. Come and join the winning team! You'll be challenged and have fun in a highly respected organization. To Learn More, Visit Matrix -ifs. Com,

description:

Tipo de vaga: Regular, período integral. De segunda a sexta-feira

Período do contrato: 10 dias úteis (incluindo treinamento) – Temporário

Local: Brasília, Brasil

Descrição da vaga:

A Aceolution está contratando com urgência Representantes de Coleta de Dados em Campo em Taipei, Taiwan, para verificar pontos de interesse (POI) com base em instruções específicas de pesquisa. Isso envolverá deslocamentos a pé até os locais designados.


No entanto, os participantes podem usar bicicletas/patinetes/outros meios de transporte, se desejarem.


Natureza do trabalho:

Verificação a pé de POIs (Pontos de Interesse), que podem incluir hotéis, postos de gasolina, restaurantes e estabelecimentos similares.

Uma lista de instalações a serem verificadas + uma camada de pontos com as localizações

Aplicativo móvel (Android/iOS) compatível com Android 10 e iOS

Recomendamos a coleta a pé; no entanto, os pesquisadores podem usar bicicleta, patinete ou outro meio de transporte, se preferirem.


Requisitos:

Residir em Brasília ou arredores, Brasil

Proficiência em inglês (leitura e conversação)

Capacidade de se deslocar a pé ou utilizar transporte para verificar o POI (Ponto de Interesse)
